## File: README.md

<div align="center">

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit/main/assets/report-assets/logo.svg" alt="MGPL Diagnostics" width="300" />

# report-studio

**The reference app: a Next.js frontend on the MGPL client SDK, with the kits as its backend.**

Copy its patterns into any MGPL app: one backend route, a fully custom UI, live previews, PDF download.

[![App](https://img.shields.io/badge/type-reference%20app-14264A)](#)
[![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-16-14264A?logo=next.js&logoColor=white)](#)
[![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19-14264A?logo=react&logoColor=white)](#)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-All%20rights%20reserved-E9A23B)](LICENSE)

</div>

### The split, in one picture

```
src/app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts   ← BACKEND (the only kit import)
src/app/**/page.tsx                    ← FRONTEND (client SDK only)
src/lib/mgpl.ts                        ← createMgplClient()
```

`next build` makes every page **static**; only `/api/mgpl/*` runs on the server. Point
`NEXT_PUBLIC_MGPL_API` at another origin and the frontend deploys on its own.
</td>
</tr>
</table>

## Pages and routes

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `/` | report gallery: design + variant toggles, print, open/download PDF |
| `/new` | **create a report**: patient + tests form generated from the catalog, live preview (`/new?demo` prefills) |
| `/invoice` | sample invoices |
| `/letterhead` | blank stationery (print borderless) |
| `/designs/index.html` | the six design options the Navy Sidebar was chosen from |
| `/api/mgpl/*` | the backend: `createMgplApi()` from invoice-kit (reports + invoices + assets) |

## Run it

```bash
npm install
npm run dev            # http://localhost:3000
```

The kits come from GitHub Packages. Add `.npmrc` (`@mgpl-diagnostics:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com`) and a
token with `read:packages`. Inside the local MGPL workspace they are linked from the sibling folders instead.

### Environment

| Variable | Side | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `MGPL_SIGNATURE_HEADER_FILE` / `MGPL_SIGNATURE_NONHEADER_FILE` | backend | path to the **real signature images**. Keep them outside git; the repo only ships a placeholder. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_MGPL_API` | frontend | backend URL if it runs elsewhere (default `/api/mgpl`) |

Put them in `.env.local` (git-ignored).

## Use these patterns in your own app

1. **Backend:** copy [`src/app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts`](src/app/api/mgpl/%5B...path%5D/route.ts), or mount the
   [Fastify plugin](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit#mount-it-anywhere) in a separate server.
2. **Frontend:** `npm i @mgpl-diagnostics/client`, create one client ([`src/lib/mgpl.ts`](src/lib/mgpl.ts)) and build your UI.
   [`src/app/new/page.tsx`](src/app/new/page.tsx) shows a complete form → preview → PDF flow.
3. **Types:** [`src/contract-check.ts`](src/contract-check.ts) fails `npm run typecheck` if the client and the kits ever disagree.

## Scripts

`dev` · `build` · `start` · `typecheck` · `designs` (regenerates `public/designs/`)

See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the rules (no rendering logic here; fix it in the kits).

## Part of MGPL Diagnostics

| Repo | Side | |
|---|---|---|
| [report-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit) | backend | reports, letterhead, templates |
| [invoice-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit) | backend | patient invoices + combined API |
| [client](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/client) | frontend | headless SDK, zero dependencies |
| **report-studio** | app | Next.js reference app |

<sub>© MGPL Diagnostics (Maa Gayatri Path Lab). All rights reserved; see [LICENSE](LICENSE). All patients shown are fictional.</sub>

## File: AGENTS.md

# AGENTS.md — report-studio

The reference Next.js 16 app (App Router, Turbopack, React 19) for MGPL Diagnostics. It demonstrates
the intended architecture:

- **Backend:** exactly one route, `src/app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts`, which mounts `createMgplApi()`
  from invoice-kit. This is the **only** file that imports a backend kit (plus `src/contract-check.ts`, types only).
- **Frontend:** every page is a client component that uses `@mgpl-diagnostics/client` (and its unstyled
  React hooks). All UI and CSS belong to this app (`src/app/globals.css`, `src/components/`).

Rendering bugs belong in the kits, not here.

## Map

```
src/app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts   backend (createMgplApi, samples enabled for the demo)
src/lib/mgpl.ts                       the client (NEXT_PUBLIC_MGPL_API or "/api/mgpl")
src/app/page.tsx                      report gallery
src/app/new/page.tsx                  result-entry form from GET /templates + live preview (?demo prefills)
src/app/invoice/page.tsx              invoice gallery
src/app/letterhead/page.tsx           blank stationery
src/components/                       Nav, Segmented, pdf-actions (popup-safe open / download)
src/contract-check.ts                 compile-time check: client types ⇄ kit types
public/designs/                       static design-option pages (scripts/design-gallery.tsx)
```

## Rules

- Before using a Next.js API, check `node_modules/next/dist/docs/`. This Next version may differ
  from your training data.
- Never import a kit from a page or component. Use the client.
- Keep `export const runtime = "nodejs"` on the API route.
- Real signatures: `MGPL_SIGNATURE_HEADER_FILE` / `MGPL_SIGNATURE_NONHEADER_FILE` in `.env.local`
  (git-ignored), pointing outside the repo. Never commit signature images.
- After changes: `npm run typecheck` (includes the contract check) and `npm run build`. The build must show
  every page as static and only `/api/mgpl/[...path]` as dynamic.

## Licence

All rights reserved (see LICENSE).

## File: llms.txt

# report-studio

> Reference Next.js 16 app for MGPL Diagnostics. Its frontend pages use only @mgpl-diagnostics/client (custom UI, live previews, PDF download, a result-entry form generated from GET /templates). Its backend is one route, `src/app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts`, mounting `createMgplApi()` from invoice-kit. `next build` renders every page static; only the API route is dynamic.

Key facts for agents:
- Never import a kit in pages; use `src/lib/mgpl.ts` (the client). Rendering changes belong in the kits.
- Real signatures: MGPL_SIGNATURE_HEADER_FILE / MGPL_SIGNATURE_NONHEADER_FILE in .env.local (git-ignored).
- `src/contract-check.ts` fails typecheck if client and kit types drift.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): pages, running, environment, patterns to copy
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): file map and rules
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): docs plus the key source files

## Source

- [src/app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts](src/app/api/mgpl/%5B...path%5D/route.ts): backend
- [src/lib/mgpl.ts](src/lib/mgpl.ts): client
- [src/app/new/page.tsx](src/app/new/page.tsx): form → preview → PDF example

## Optional

- [report-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit)

## File: scripts/design-gallery.tsx

```tsx
// Design exploration: renders the same report in 6 new layouts (HTML only) so one can be
// picked before it is built into the kit (HTML + PDF).
//   npx tsx scripts/design-gallery.tsx  ->  public/designs/index.html  (/designs/index.html on the dev server)
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import QRCode from "qrcode";
import { barcodeSvg, buildReport, formatDoctor, fullName, MGPL_LAB, resolveFlag, TEMPLATES, type Patient, type Row } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";

const out = join(process.cwd(), "public", "designs");
mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ demo data */
const patient: Patient = { title: "Mrs", name: "Kavita Sharma", age: 32, sex: "Female", patientId: "MGPL1025", refDoctor: "A. K. Sharma", sampleCollectionDate: "12-10-2026" };
const meta = {
  sampleId: "S2610120398",
  sampleType: "Whole Blood (EDTA)",
  collected: "12-10-2026 08:45 AM",
  registered: "12-10-2026 09:02 AM",
  reported: "12-10-2026 01:30 PM",
  verifyUrl: "https://mgpl.example/verify/MGPL1025", // placeholder until the real verify URL exists
};
const report = buildReport(patient, [{ template: "cbc", results: TEMPLATES.cbc.sample }]);
const rows: Row[] = report.sections[0].rows;
const lab = MGPL_LAB;
const A = "/api/mgpl/assets/report-assets"; // served by the backend route

const esc = (s: string) => s.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- shared markup */
async function page(n: number, opts: { sidebar?: boolean; cards?: boolean }) {
  const qr = await QRCode.toString(meta.verifyUrl, { type: "svg", margin: 0, errorCorrectionLevel: "M" });
  const bar = barcodeSvg(patient.patientId!)!;
  const field = (k: string, v: string, strong = false) => `<div class="f"><span class="k">${k}</span><span class="v${strong ? " strong" : ""}">${esc(v)}</span></div>`;

  let body = "";
  let group = "";
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (r.kind === "heading") {
      if (group) body += `</tbody>`;
      body += `<tbody><tr class="sub"><td colspan="5">${esc(r.text)}</td></tr>`;
      group = r.text;
      continue;
    }
    if (r.kind !== "test") continue;
    const flag = resolveFlag(r);
    const ab = flag !== "normal";
    const fl = flag === "high" ? "H" : flag === "low" ? "L" : "";
    body += `<tr class="${ab ? "ab" : ""}"><td class="name">${esc(r.name)}${r.abbr ? ` <span class="abbr">${esc(r.abbr)}</span>` : ""}</td>
      <td class="res">${esc(r.result ?? "")}</td><td class="flag">${fl ? `<span class="pill ${flag}">${fl}</span>` : ""}</td>
      <td class="unit">${esc(r.unit ?? "")}</td><td class="range">${esc(Array.isArray(r.range) ? r.range.join(", ") : r.range ?? "")}</td></tr>`;
  }
  body += `</tbody>`;

  const table = `<table class="results">
      <colgroup><col class="c-name"><col class="c-res"><col class="c-flag"><col class="c-unit"><col class="c-range"></colgroup>
      <thead><tr><th class="name">Test Description</th><th class="res">Result</th><th class="flag">Flag</th><th class="unit">Unit</th><th class="range">Biological Ref. Interval</th></tr></thead>
      ${body}</table>`;

  return `<div class="page d${n}">
  ${opts.sidebar ? `<aside class="side"><span>${esc(lab.name.toUpperCase())}</span></aside>` : ""}
  <header class="lh">
    <img class="logo" src="${A}/logo.svg" alt="${esc(lab.name)}">
    <div class="contact">
      <div class="addr">${lab.addressLines.map(esc).join("<br>")}</div>
      <div class="ci"><img src="${A}/icon-phone.svg" alt="">${esc(lab.phone)}</div>
      <div class="ci"><img src="${A}/icon-email.svg" alt="">${esc(lab.email)}</div>
    </div>
  </header>
  <div class="accent"></div>
  <section class="patient">
    <div class="fields">
      ${field("Patient Name", fullName(patient), true)}
      ${field("Age / Sex", `${patient.age} Year(s) / ${patient.sex}`)}
      ${field("Patient ID", patient.patientId!)}
      ${field("Ref. Doctor", formatDoctor(patient.refDoctor))}
      ${field("Sample ID", meta.sampleId)}
      ${field("Sample Type", meta.sampleType)}
      ${field("Collected", meta.collected)}
      ${field("Registered", meta.registered)}
      ${field("Reported", meta.reported)}
    </div>
    <div class="codes">
      <div class="barcode">${bar}</div>
      <div class="qr">${qr}<span>Scan to verify</span></div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <div class="${opts.cards ? "card" : "plain"}">
    <h2 class="dept"><span>HEMATOLOGY</span></h2>
    <div class="test-title">Complete Blood Count (CBC)<small>Method: Automated Cell Counter &nbsp;•&nbsp; Specimen: ${esc(meta.sampleType)}</small></div>
    ${table}
  </div>
  <div class="notes"><b>Note:</b> Values marked <span class="pill high">H</span> / <span class="pill low">L</span> are above / below the biological reference interval. Results should be correlated clinically.</div>
  <div class="end">— End of Report —</div>
  <footer>
    <div class="signs">
      <div class="qc"><img src="${A}/qc-stamp.svg" alt="QC approved"></div>
      <div class="sign"><img src="${A}/signature-placeholder.svg" alt="Signature"><b>${esc(lab.signatory.name)}</b><span>${esc(lab.signatory.designation)}</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="legal"><span>This is an electronically verified report. Scan the QR code to confirm authenticity.</span><span>Page 1 of 1</span></div>
  </footer>
</div>`;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- base CSS */
const BASE = `
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{background:#d9dce3}
body{padding:24px 0}
.page{position:relative;width:210mm;height:297mm;margin:0 auto;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18);display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:0 .45in;color:#111}
.page img{display:block}
.lh{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-top:.3in}
.logo{height:.95in}
.contact{text-align:right;font-size:9pt;line-height:1.45}
.ci{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:5px}
.ci img{width:11px;height:11px}
.patient{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:.2in}
.fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:4px 18px;flex:1}
.f{display:flex;flex-direction:column}

.v{font-size:9.5pt}
.v.strong{font-weight:700}

.barcode svg{width:1.45in;height:.36in;display:block}
.qr{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;font-size:6.5pt;gap:2px}
.qr svg{width:.78in;height:.78in;display:block}
.results{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:8.6pt}
.results col.c-name{width:45%}.results col.c-res{width:11%}.results col.c-flag{width:7%}.results col.c-unit{width:13%}.results col.c-range{width:24%}
.results td.name{white-space:nowrap}
.results th{text-align:left;font-weight:700}
.results td,.results th{padding:2.6px 6px}
.results .res,.results .flag,.results .unit,.results .range{text-align:center}
.results .abbr{font-weight:600}
.results tr.ab .res{font-weight:700}
.pill{display:inline-block;min-width:15px;padding:0 4px;border-radius:3px;font-size:7pt;font-weight:700;line-height:13px;text-align:center;color:#fff}
.pill.high{background:#d92d20}.pill.low{background:#1570ef}
.test-title{font-weight:700;font-size:10.5pt;margin:2px 0 4px}
.test-title small{display:block;font-weight:400;font-size:7.5pt;opacity:.7}
.notes{font-size:7.5pt;margin-top:8px;line-height:1.5}
.notes .pill{transform:scale(.9)}
.end{text-align:center;font-size:7.5pt;letter-spacing:.2em;margin-top:8px;opacity:.7}
footer{margin-top:auto;padding-bottom:.25in}
.signs{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:flex-end;gap:.5in}
.qc img{width:.72in;height:.72in}
.sign{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;font-size:9pt}
.sign img{width:1.4in;height:.47in;object-fit:contain}
.legal{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:6.8pt;margin-top:8px;padding-top:5px;border-top:1px solid #ccd;opacity:.85}
@media print{html,body{background:#fff;padding:0}.page{box-shadow:none;margin:0}}
@page{size:A4;margin:0}
`;

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- 6 designs */

  title: string;
  fonts: string;
  google: string;

async function main() {
  for (const [k, d] of designs.entries()) {
    const html = `<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Design ${k + 1} — ${d.title}</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?${d.google}&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>${BASE}${d.css}</style></head><body>${await page(k + 1, d.opts ?? {})}</body></html>`;
    writeFileSync(join(out, `${d.id}.html`), html);
    console.log(`design ${k + 1}: ${d.title}`);
  }

  const cards = designs
    .map(
      (d, k) => `<article><div class="frame"><iframe src="${d.id}.html" loading="lazy" title="${d.title}" tabindex="-1"></iframe></div>
  <h2><span>${k + 1}</span>${d.title}</h2><p class="font">${d.fonts}</p><p>${d.about}</p><a href="${d.id}.html" target="_blank">Open full size</a></article>`,
    )
    .join("\n");

  writeFileSync(
    join(out, "index.html"),
    `<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>MGPL — Report Designs</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;font-family:system-ui,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;background:#f4f5f8;color:#1c2230;padding:28px 16px}

article{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:14px;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.frame{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:210/297;overflow:hidden;border-radius:6px;background:#d9dce3}
.frame iframe{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:820px;height:1160px;border:0;transform-origin:0 0;pointer-events:none}
h2{font-size:17px;margin:12px 0 2px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
h2 span{background:#14264A;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;width:24px;height:24px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
p{margin:2px 0;font-size:13px;color:#475467}.font{color:#C2410C;font-weight:600}
a{display:inline-block;margin-top:8px;color:#14264A;font-weight:600;font-size:13px}
</style></head><body>
<header><h1>Report design options</h1><p>Same CBC report in 6 layouts — each with barcode + QR code. Tell me the number you like.</p></header>
<div class="grid">${cards}</div>
<script>

function fit(){document.querySelectorAll('.frame').forEach(f=>{const i=f.querySelector('iframe');i.style.transform='scale('+(f.clientWidth/820)+')';});}
addEventListener('resize',fit);fit();
</script></body></html>`,
  );

}

## File: scripts/llms-full.mjs

````js
// Builds llms-full.txt: every doc and source file of the repo in one plain-text document for AI tools.
//   node scripts/llms-full.mjs "<title>" <file-or-folder> [file-or-folder …]
// Folders are walked recursively. Output order: README, AGENTS, docs, then the rest alphabetically.
// Skipped: build output, dependencies, lockfiles, generated files, binaries. Files over 150 KB are
// listed (path + size) instead of inlined. CI checks the file is up to date (`npm run llms` + git diff).
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { extname, join, relative } from "node:path";

const [title, ...inputs] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!title || !inputs.length) {
  console.error('usage: node scripts/llms-full.mjs "<title>" <file-or-folder> …');
  process.exit(1);
}

const TEXT = new Set([".ts", ".tsx", ".mts", ".cts", ".js", ".mjs", ".cjs", ".md", ".mdx", ".json", ".css", ".yml", ".yaml", ".txt", ".graphql", ".gql", ".sql", ".html"]);
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(["node_modules", "dist", ".next", ".git", ".turbo", "coverage", "examples", ".pg-test"]);
const SKIP_FILES = /(^|\/)(package-lock\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml|yarn\.lock|llms-full\.txt|[^/]*\.generated\.[^/]+|[^/]*\.log)$/;
const MAX = 150 * 1024;
const LANG = { ".ts": "ts", ".tsx": "tsx", ".mts": "ts", ".cts": "ts", ".js": "js", ".mjs": "js", ".cjs": "js", ".json": "json", ".css": "css", ".yml": "yaml", ".yaml": "yaml", ".graphql": "graphql", ".gql": "graphql", ".sql": "sql", ".html": "html" };

const posix = (p) => p.split("\\").join("/");
const files = new Set();
function walk(p) {
  const st = statSync(p);
  if (st.isDirectory()) {
    for (const name of readdirSync(p)) if (!SKIP_DIRS.has(name)) walk(join(p, name));
  } else if (TEXT.has(extname(p).toLowerCase()) && !SKIP_FILES.test(posix(p))) {
    files.add(posix(relative(".", p)));
  }
}
for (const input of inputs) walk(input);

const rank = (f) => (/^README\.md$/i.test(f) ? 0 : /^AGENTS\.md$/i.test(f) ? 1 : /^docs\//.test(f) ? 2 : 3);
const ordered = [...files].sort((a, b) => rank(a) - rank(b) || (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));

const parts = [`# ${title} — full documentation and source\n\n> Generated by scripts/llms-full.mjs. Do not edit by hand. ${ordered.length} files.\n\n## Contents\n\n${ordered.map((f) => `- ${f}`).join("\n")}\n`];
const omitted = [];
for (const f of ordered) {
  // LF-normalised text, so Windows and Linux checkouts produce byte-identical output
  const body = readFileSync(f, "utf8").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").trim();
  const size = Buffer.byteLength(body);
  if (size > MAX) {
    omitted.push(`${f} (${(size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB)`);
    parts.push(`\n\n---\n\n## File: ${f}\n\n_Omitted: ${(size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB. Read the file directly._\n`);
    continue;
  }
  const lang = LANG[extname(f).toLowerCase()];
  const fence = body.includes("```") ? "````" : "```";
  parts.push(`\n\n---\n\n## File: ${f}\n\n${lang ? `${fence}${lang}\n${body}\n${fence}` : body}\n`);
}
const out = parts.join("");
writeFileSync("llms-full.txt", out);
console.log(`llms-full.txt: ${ordered.length} files, ${(out.length / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB${omitted.length ? `; omitted (too large): ${omitted.join(", ")}` : ""}`);
````

```ts
// BACKEND — the only place this app touches the MGPL kits. Everything under /api/mgpl/* is served
// by createMgplApi(): templates, reports, invoices, letterhead, fonts/images. The pages call it
// through @mgpl-diagnostics/client, exactly as a separate frontend app (or another domain) would.
import { createMgplApi } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

const api = createMgplApi({
  basePath: "/api/mgpl",
  samples: true, // demo data for the preview pages; leave off in production
});

export { api as GET, api as POST, api as OPTIONS };

## File: src/app/invoice/page.tsx

```tsx
"use client";
// FRONTEND page: invoices rendered by the backend, shown with the studio's own UI.
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { ReportVariant } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/client";
import { HtmlFrame, useAsync, useInvoiceHtml, type HtmlFrameHandle } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/client/react";
import { Nav } from "@/components/Nav";
import { openPdf, savePdf } from "@/components/pdf-actions";
import { Segmented } from "@/components/Segmented";
import { mgpl } from "@/lib/mgpl";

export default function InvoicePage() {
  const samples = useAsync(() => mgpl.invoices.samples(), "invoice-samples");
  const [sample, setSample] = useState("paid");
  const [variant, setVariant] = useState<ReportVariant>("header");
  const request = { sample, variant };
  const preview = useInvoiceHtml(mgpl, request);
  const frame = useRef<HtmlFrameHandle>(null);
  const current = samples.data?.find((s) => s.id === sample);
  return (
    <>
      <Nav active="/invoice" />
      <div className="app">
        <aside className="sidebar">
          <nav aria-label="Invoices">
            <h2>Sample invoices</h2>
            {samples.data?.map((s) => (
              <button key={s.id} className="navitem" aria-current={s.id === sample ? "page" : undefined} onClick={() => setSample(s.id)}>
                {s.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </nav>
        </aside>
        <main className="main">
          <div className="toolbar">
            <Segmented value={variant} onChange={setVariant} options={[["header", "Header"], ["non-header", "Non-header"]]} label="Variant" />
            <span className="spacer" />
            <button className="btn secondary" onClick={() => frame.current?.print()}>
              Print
            </button>
            <button className="btn secondary" onClick={() => openPdf(() => mgpl.invoices.pdf(request))}>
              Open PDF
            </button>
            <button className="btn" onClick={() => savePdf(() => mgpl.invoices.pdf(request), `${current?.invoiceNo ?? sample}.pdf`.replace(/\//g, "-"))}>
              Download PDF
            </button>
            <div className="meta">
              {current?.invoiceNo} {current && `· ${current.label}`} · sample prices{preview.loading && " · rendering…"}
            </div>
          </div>
          {preview.error && <p className="error">{preview.error.message}</p>}
          <div className="preview">{preview.data && <HtmlFrame ref={frame} html={preview.data} title="Invoice preview" />}</div>
        </main>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

## File: src/app/new/page.tsx

```tsx
"use client";
// FRONTEND page: a result-entry form generated from GET /templates, with a live backend preview.
// Shows how an app builds its own UI on @mgpl-diagnostics/client — the kits never render this form.
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { Patient, ReportRequest, ReportVariant, Results, TemplateInfo } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/client";
import { HtmlFrame, useReportHtml, useTemplates, type HtmlFrameHandle } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/client/react";
import { Nav } from "@/components/Nav";
import { openPdf, savePdf } from "@/components/pdf-actions";
import { Segmented } from "@/components/Segmented";
import { mgpl } from "@/lib/mgpl";

const EMPTY_PATIENT: Patient = { title: "Mr", name: "", age: "", sex: "Male", patientId: "", refDoctor: "Self", sampleId: "" };

/** debounce a value so the preview doesn't re-render on every keystroke */
function useDebounced<T>(value: T, ms: number): T {
  const [v, setV] = useState(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setTimeout(() => setV(value), ms);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [value, ms]);
  return v;
}

export default function NewReportPage() {
  const catalog = useTemplates(mgpl);
  const [patient, setPatient] = useState<Patient>(EMPTY_PATIENT);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string[]>(["cbc"]);
  const [results, setResults] = useState<Record<string, Results>>({});
  const [variant, setVariant] = useState<ReportVariant>("header");
  const frame = useRef<HtmlFrameHandle>(null);

  // /new?demo fills the form with fictional data (used for screenshots and demos)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).has("demo")) return;
    setPatient({ title: "Mrs", name: "Kavita Sharma", age: "32", sex: "Female", patientId: "MGPL1025", refDoctor: "Self", sampleId: "S2610120398" });
    setSelected(["hb", "blood-sugar"]);
    setResults({ hb: { hb: "10.8" }, "blood-sugar": { bsf: "96", bspp: "182" } });
  }, []);

  const byCategory = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, TemplateInfo[]>();
    for (const t of catalog.data?.templates ?? []) m.set(t.category ?? "Other", [...(m.get(t.category ?? "Other") ?? []), t]);
    return [...m.entries()];
  }, [catalog.data]);

  const ready = patient.name.trim() && String(patient.age).trim() && selected.length > 0;
  const request: ReportRequest | null = ready
    ? { patient: { ...patient, age: Number(patient.age) || patient.age }, tests: selected.map((id) => ({ template: id, results: results[id] ?? {} })), variant }
    : null;
  const debounced = useDebounced(request, 600);
  const preview = useReportHtml(mgpl, debounced);

  const setField = (tpl: string, key: string, value: string) => setResults((r) => ({ ...r, [tpl]: { ...r[tpl], [key]: value } }));
  const toggle = (id: string) => setSelected((s) => (s.includes(id) ? s.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...s, id]));
  const p = (k: keyof Patient) => ({
    value: String(patient[k] ?? ""),
    onChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement>) => setPatient({ ...patient, [k]: e.target.value }),
  });

  return (
    <>
      <Nav active="/new" />
      <div className="app builder">
        <aside className="sidebar form">
          <h2>Patient</h2>
          <div className="grid2">
            <label>
              Title
              <select {...p("title")}>
                {["Mr", "Mrs", "Ms", "Master", "Ku", "Baby"].map((t) => (
                  <option key={t}>{t}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
            <label>
              Name
              <input {...p("name")} placeholder="Full name" />
            </label>
            <label>
              Age
              <input {...p("age")} inputMode="numeric" placeholder="Years" />
            </label>
            <label>
              Sex
              <select {...p("sex")}>
                <option>Male</option>
                <option>Female</option>
                <option>Other</option>
              </select>
            </label>
            <label>
              Patient ID
              <input {...p("patientId")} placeholder="MGPL1234" />
            </label>
            <label>
              Sample ID
              <input {...p("sampleId")} />
            </label>
            <label className="wide">
              Ref. doctor
              <input {...p("refDoctor")} />
            </label>
          </div>

          <h2>Tests</h2>
          {catalog.error && <p className="error">{catalog.error.message}</p>}
          {byCategory.map(([cat, tpls]) => (
            <details key={cat} open={cat === "Hematology"}>
              <summary>{cat}</summary>
              {tpls.map((t) => (
                <label key={t.id} className="check">
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={selected.includes(t.id)} onChange={() => toggle(t.id)} /> {t.name}
                </label>
              ))}
            </details>
          ))}

          {selected.map((id) => {
            const t = catalog.data?.templates.find((x) => x.id === id);
            if (!t) return null;
            return (
              <fieldset key={id}>
                <legend>{t.name}</legend>
                {t.fields.map((f) => (
                  <label key={f.key} className="result">
                    <span>{f.label}</span>
                    <input value={String(results[id]?.[f.key] ?? "")} onChange={(e) => setField(id, f.key, e.target.value)} placeholder={Array.isArray(f.range) ? f.range[0] : f.range} />
                    <small>{f.unit}</small>
                  </label>
                ))}
              </fieldset>
            );
          })}
        </aside>

        <main className="main">
          <div className="toolbar">
            <Segmented value={variant} onChange={setVariant} options={[["header", "Header"], ["non-header", "Non-header"]]} label="Variant" />
            <span className="spacer" />
            <button className="btn secondary" disabled={!request} onClick={() => frame.current?.print()}>
              Print
            </button>
            <button className="btn secondary" disabled={!request} onClick={() => request && openPdf(() => mgpl.reports.pdf(request))}>
              Open PDF
            </button>
            <button className="btn" disabled={!request} onClick={() => request && savePdf(() => mgpl.reports.pdf(request), `${patient.patientId || "report"}.pdf`)}>
              Download PDF
            </button>
            <div className="meta">{!request ? "Enter name, age and pick at least one test" : preview.loading ? "rendering…" : "Live preview — rendered by the backend"}</div>
          </div>
          {preview.error && <p className="error">{preview.error.message}</p>}
          <div className="preview">{debounced && preview.data && <HtmlFrame ref={frame} html={preview.data} title="Report preview" />}</div>
        </main>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

## File: src/app/page.tsx

```tsx
"use client";
// FRONTEND page: only @mgpl-diagnostics/client is used here. The backend (/api/mgpl) renders.
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { ReportDesign, ReportVariant, SampleInfo } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/client";
import { HtmlFrame, useAsync, useReportHtml, type HtmlFrameHandle } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/client/react";
import { Nav } from "@/components/Nav";
import { Segmented } from "@/components/Segmented";
import { openPdf, savePdf } from "@/components/pdf-actions";
import { mgpl } from "@/lib/mgpl";

const GROUPS: { key: SampleInfo["group"]; label: string }[] = [
  { key: "design", label: "From the Word designs" },
  { key: "template", label: "More tests" },
  { key: "profile", label: "Profiles" },
];

export default function ReportsPage() {
  const samples = useAsync(() => mgpl.reports.samples(), "samples");
  const [sample, setSample] = useState("cbc");
  const [variant, setVariant] = useState<ReportVariant>("header");
  const [design, setDesign] = useState<ReportDesign>("sidebar");
  const request = { sample, variant, design };
  const preview = useReportHtml(mgpl, request);
  const frame = useRef<HtmlFrameHandle>(null);
  const current = samples.data?.find((s) => s.id === sample);

  return (
    <>
      <Nav active="/" />
      <div className="app">
        <aside className="sidebar">
          {samples.error && <p className="error">{samples.error.message}</p>}
          {GROUPS.map((g) => (
            <nav key={g.key} aria-label={g.label}>
              <h2>{g.label}</h2>
              {samples.data
                ?.filter((s) => s.group === g.key)
                .map((s) => (
                  <button key={s.id} className="navitem" aria-current={s.id === sample ? "page" : undefined} onClick={() => setSample(s.id)}>
                    {s.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
            </nav>
          ))}
        </aside>
        <main className="main">
          <div className="toolbar">
            <Segmented value={design} onChange={setDesign} options={[["sidebar", "Navy Sidebar"], ["classic", "Classic"]]} label="Design" />
            <Segmented value={variant} onChange={setVariant} options={[["header", "Header"], ["non-header", "Non-header"]]} label="Variant" />
            <span className="spacer" />
            <button className="btn secondary" onClick={() => frame.current?.print()}>
              Print
            </button>
            <button className="btn secondary" onClick={() => openPdf(() => mgpl.reports.pdf(request))}>
              Open PDF
            </button>
            <button className="btn" onClick={() => savePdf(() => mgpl.reports.pdf(request), `${sample}-${design}-${variant}.pdf`)}>
              Download PDF
            </button>
            <div className="meta">
              {current ? `${current.label} · ${current.source}` : " "}
              {preview.loading && " · rendering…"}
            </div>
          </div>
          {preview.error && <p className="error">{preview.error.message}</p>}
          <div className="preview">{preview.data && <HtmlFrame ref={frame} html={preview.data} title="Report preview" />}</div>
        </main>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

import Link from "next/link";

const LINKS = [
  { href: "/", label: "Reports" },
  { href: "/new", label: "Create report" },
  { href: "/invoice", label: "Invoices" },
  { href: "/letterhead", label: "Letterhead" },
];

/** App navigation — this UI belongs to the studio, not to the kits. */
export function Nav({ active }: { active: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="topnav">
      <strong>MGPL Report Studio</strong>
      {LINKS.map((l) => (
        <Link key={l.href} href={l.href} aria-current={l.href === active ? "page" : undefined}>
          {l.label}
        </Link>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

## File: src/components/Segmented.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

export function Segmented<T extends string>({ value, onChange, options, label }: { value: T; onChange: (v: T) => void; options: [T, string][]; label: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="seg" role="group" aria-label={label}>
      {options.map(([v, text]) => (
        <button key={v} aria-pressed={value === v} onClick={() => onChange(v)}>
          {text}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## File: src/components/pdf-actions.ts

```ts
"use client";
// Open/download helpers. A tab is opened synchronously (inside the click) so popup blockers allow it,
// then pointed at the PDF once the backend returns it.
import { downloadBlob } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/client";

export async function openPdf(load: () => Promise<Blob>) {
  const tab = window.open("", "_blank");
  try {
    const blob = await load();
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    if (tab) tab.location.href = url;
    else window.location.href = url;
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 120_000);
  } catch (e) {
    tab?.close();
    alert((e as Error).message);
  }
}

export async function savePdf(load: () => Promise<Blob>, fileName: string) {
  try {
    downloadBlob(await load(), fileName);
  } catch (e) {
    alert((e as Error).message);
  }
}
```


---

## File: src/contract-check.ts

```ts
// Compile-time check that the client's contract types match what the backend kits accept/return.
// `npm run typecheck` fails here if the client and the kits drift apart.
import type * as C from "@mgpl-diagnostics/client";
import type * as I from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit";
import type * as K from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";

type Assert<T extends true> = T;
type Extends<A, B> = [A] extends [B] ? true : false;

// what the client sends must be accepted by the server
export type PatientIn = Assert<Extends<C.Patient, K.Patient>>;
export type InvoiceIn = Assert<Extends<C.InvoiceInput, I.BuildInvoiceInput>>;
export type PaymentIn = Assert<Extends<C.Payment, I.Payment>>;
export type ItemIn = Assert<Extends<C.InvoiceItem, I.InvoiceItem>>;
export type VariantIn = Assert<Extends<C.ReportVariant, K.ReportVariant>>;
export type DesignIn = Assert<Extends<C.ReportDesign, K.ReportDesign>>;
// what the server returns must satisfy the client's types
export type CatalogOut = Assert<Extends<K.TemplateCatalog, C.TemplateCatalog>>;
export type TotalsOut = Assert<Extends<ReturnType<typeof I.invoiceTotalsJson>, C.InvoiceTotals>>;
export type SampleOut = Assert<Extends<K.SampleInfo, C.SampleInfo>>;
```
